es.why: Compiled lazy Spanish catalog; growth requires a measured reason, independently of shell bytes. Ceilings rounded up to 1 KiB to absorb import-hash compression differences. Its size includes Spanish `many` on 94 plural selects ("1.000.000 de puestos") and repaired translations that compile instead of falling back; new English messages shift the message numbers the catalog carries even when no Spanish message changes. The top bar's chip for a running matching-model download or switch grows it too. It also carries the translations that had fallen behind English: the plugin settings and their approval dialogs, the Stock prices card, company benefits and offers, and Settings > Privacy. The scan control's reasons a queued scan waits on the background service, and the Stock prices card's update states, grow it too. Each screen's own whole loading, failure, empty and refresh lines, in place of a frame built around a noun, grow it too, as do the Insights tab's KPI words, the disclosure groupings and the pay basis' name. Whole-sentence messages in place of fragments the code joined, on the schedule screen, the company register, Insights and Compare, grow it too, as do the review and job-detail screens' statuses, roles and counts said inside their sentences. Native launcher setup and shared hold messages add translated catalog entries. The unified native setup and actionable login guidance add translated app-installation, manual-drag and service-state messages. The localized disk-image installation and first-open guide add native installer messages. Native Scan now/Stop scan actions and their request outcomes add ten shared-catalog messages. Guarded native engine Start and local diagnostics add eleven shared-catalog messages. The native installed-version What's New window and local release banner add nine shared-catalog messages. The native update preferences, release preview and manual update instructions add 21 shared-catalog messages; the consent and its three choices remain English-only. The four-stage visual pre-launch installation guide adds 36 shared messages for navigation, recovery and screenshot descriptions. Native launch-mode guidance and owned-engine recovery add shared-catalog messages. The four native first-open pages add 43 shared messages for preparation, offline progress, login choice and Ready. The native tabbed panel and its in-place update add shared-catalog messages for the tabs, the settings links, the update states and the notices after an update. The menu-bar scan picture (its titles, tank labels, schedule line, Pause and accessibility summaries) adds launcher messages. The pipeline's toolbar, filter and column menus add English messages that shift the message numbers it carries. The application pipeline translated in full (its board, one application's page, Up next and the month beside it) adds its Spanish messages. Following a company scanned only at the person's direction adds its Spanish messages: Follow and scan, the Keep scanning choice and its hint, the register's schedule button and its toasts, and the line when a first scan has to wait.

Each screen's own whole loading, failure, empty and refresh lines, in place of a frame built around a noun; the Insights tab's KPI words, the disclosure groupings and the pay basis' name. The compensation words grow it too: total compensation, posted range, comp band and minimum base in place of shorter words, and the full words behind each TC label for hover and screen readers.
